{"name":"4c38ab5bfa7caf69efc7","layouts":[{"id":0,"position":{"x":16.25,"y":343.75,"z":5000,"width":1290,"height":346.25,"tabOrder":5000}}],"singleVisual":{"visualType":"textbox","drillFilterOtherVisuals":true,"objects":{"general":[{"properties":{"paragraphs":[{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Local Identification/Specific Patient Identification:","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","textDecoration":"underline"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Patients are identified within this report, as being dementia diagnosed patients, via Primary Care and their QOF dementia coding. If a patient has the relevant QOF coding for dementia, 'QOF48_DEM_REG', then we can identify the specific patient and they are then included in any local data relating to dementia. For instance the number of A&E attendances for dementia patients is calculated by analysing the patients identified locally as being diagnosed with dementia and then ascertaining as to whether they have attended A&E. This A&E attendance would only be counted if the attendance took place on the day of or after the patient's dementia diagnosis date. The data table for the QOF diagnosis is [CCG_Current].[PrimaryCare].[vw_LongTermConditions]."}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"National Patient Identification:","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","textDecoration":"underline"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Practice, PCN, Locality, ICB and region dementia cohorts are identified via national data found via: https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/publications/statistical/primary-care-dementia-data. This page contains data files detailing the number of diagnosed patients with dementia for GP practices, ICBs and regions. This data source also includes the number of total expected dementia patients for each ICB or region, it does not detail this information for GP practices.  "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Demographics:","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","textDecoration":"underline"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"This page contains data relating to diagnosed dementia patients who are currently alive and registered within Gloucestershire. It contains various demographics data, such as age, sex, ethnicity etc. which are sourced from various data tables and sources. Primarily this data is sourced from our overall current patient demographics data table: [BIReports].[MPI].[MPI_current]."}]}]}}]}}}

{"name":"afceeed90089c2699fce","layouts":[{"id":0,"position":{"x":16.25,"y":93.75,"z":0,"width":1612.5,"height":306.25,"tabOrder":0}}],"singleVisual":{"visualType":"textbox","drillFilterOtherVisuals":true,"objects":{"general":[{"properties":{"paragraphs":[{"textRuns":[{"value":"Dementia Diagnosis Rate (DDR):","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","textDecoration":"underline"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The dementia diagnosis rate (DDR) compares the number of patients, aged 65 and over, who is thought to have dementia by the number of patients diagnosed with dementia. The target DDR is for at least two thirds, 66.7%, of dementia patients to be diagnosed. The DDR is provided via NHSE England, who tabulate the number of diagnosed and suspected dementia patients to then calculate the DDR for Gloucestershire ICB. A local DDR is calculated based on locally identified patients, as explained below. "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The number of expected dementia patients is calculated by taking the number of 65+ year old patients from the first day of the month following the reporting month, e.g. if the reporting month was November then the population data would be from the 1st of December. The number of expected dementia patients is derived using an expected dementia rate for each 5-year aged sex cohort. This dementia rate is multiplied by the number of patients in that cohort, to derive the expected dementia population for the cohort. This is then totalled to create the expected number of dementia patients for Gloucestershire ICB. You can see the dementia expectancy rates at the bottom of the page. "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"With the ability to locally identify patients, we can calculate the expected dementia population for any cohort within the county including individual GP practices. Therefore any grouping of patients which is not an ICB, such as PCNs and GP practices, is calculated using local population data and the expected dementia rates. This means the ICB DDRs are provided by NHSE but any other DDR is calculated locally via this report and our local data."}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The number of dementia patients is determined, by NHSE, via data extraction from GP clinical systems on the last day of the month of the reporting period, e.g. if the reporting month was November then it would be the number of diagnosed dementia patients on the 30th of November. This number is divided by the expected dementia population and the DDR is calculated for that reporting period."}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]}]}}]}}}
